title: Record no-change when the surface already solves the task
problemCues: Review or audit of an existing screen that may already be usable
preconditions: Screenshot and measure available; agent inspected real states
decision: Prefer verdict no-change with verdictEvidence and every diagnosis bucket checked. Do not invent defects to fill a quota or inflate severity.
tradeoffs: Fewer visible edits; higher trust that changes are necessary
exceptions: Named evidenced defects across usability, completeness, composition, craft, or adoption — one real defect is enough
example: Audit mode packet with editing.allowed false
validatedBy: validateDiagnosis rejects empty defects without no-change; accepts no-change with full checked list
